excerpt: A summary of the C++ systems engineering paradigms I currently …
headings: Build novel computational forms based on real needs. Build a direct solution to the problem at hand with a minimal set of technologies. Avoid explanatory comments; make the code self-explanatory. Ship documentation, unit tests, and build instructions inside every compilation unit In non-performance-critical code, split out as many functions as possible so that each function does only one thing. Avoid exceptions whenever possible; use the result monad instead. Classify the errors in the system from day one, and define responsibility boundaries clearly Treat local errors that must be handled in place with care. Implement polymorphism with FTADLE. Make user-defined types as trivial as possible Express constraints with strong types
title: Idiomatic Practices in C++ Systems Engineering
